previousEscalations.reason: AI-DLC guardrail hook blocked Phase 3 implementation: limits.maxFilesChanged: 20 in .ai-dlc/config.json is too tight to ship Phase 3 in a single PR. Phase 3 needs 8 new source files (src/oauth/{device-codes,issuer,routes,scopes,pairings,revocation,errors,rate-limit}.ts), 8 new unit test files, and 2 modified (src/server.ts, src/config/env.ts). 2 source files written, 8 test files written (TDD red observed), then hook rejected the next 4 source files with 'change would exceed maxFilesChanged (21)'. Even serial writes were rejected. Hook treats every attempted Write as counted against the cap. Per AI-DLC rules: stop and escalate. Wrote escalation draft to .ai-dlc/escalation.md but the hook blocked the write of that file too.
options: (a) Increase maxFilesChanged for this ticket only (e.g., 30) — single PR, faster, but lowers the global cap guardrail
(b) Split Phase 3 into 3a (stores + errors + scopes) and 3b (routes + issuer + rate-limit + server/env wiring) — two PRs, each under 20, honors policy
(c) Move full unit coverage to Phase 7 — ship Phase 3 with only smoke tests, fastest but defers coverage target
previousEscalations.recommendation: (b) Split into 3a + 3b. Honors working-agreement 'never weaken tests' and stop-condition policy. Keeps per-PR rollback granularity. No cap change needed.
